name: Rentiloq – Equipment Rental for WooCommerce
author: arhamashfaq

sections.description:
Rentiloq is a specialized WooCommerce rental plugin designed specifically for physical products and equipment rentals.

Whether you rent audiovisual gear, tools, camera equipment, party supplies, bicycles, costumes, or furniture, Rentiloq allows your customers to select rental pickup and return dates once and shop only inventory available for those dates.

Key Features in Free Edition

  • Dedicated Rental Product Type: Convert any WooCommerce product into a rentable physical item with daily rates.
  • Store-Wide Date Selector: Allow shoppers to pick rental dates once and add multiple available products to a single rental cart.
  • Live Date Availability Engine: Prevents double-booking using server-side half-open date interval calculation [start_at, end_at).
  • Turnaround Buffer Days: Automatically block buffer days after returns for maintenance and preparation.
  • WooCommerce HPOS & Blocks Native: Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and Cart/Checkout Blocks out of the box.
  • Extensible Hook API: Clean action and filter hooks allowing seamless integration with Rentiloq Pro.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rentiloq-equipment-rental-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Edit any WooCommerce product and select the ‘Rental Product’ type or enable rental mode in the Rental Settings tab.
sections.faq:
Does Rentiloq require a third-party SaaS or external API?

No. Everything runs natively inside your WordPress and WooCommerce installation.

Is Rentiloq compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes! Rentiloq is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and Cart/Checkout Blocks.
